title: Erase a person's data
description: Removes one person from this company's records, found by email. Records you must keep (invoices, bookings, appointments) stay with their amounts but lose the name and contact details; medical histories, X-rays, licences, ID scans and messages are deleted for good. Their login and other companies' records are not touched.
nothingFound: This company holds nothing about this email address.
confirmDescription: This cannot be undone. Type the email address again to confirm.
